5972:3662.name: *Button/Stroke
5972:3662.description:
Status: 🔵 Ready for Review

Atomic tier: Atom.

Outlined (secondary) button for medium-emphasis actions, usually paired with *Button/Fill.

Props:
- label: text override.
- icon: instance swap.
- State: Default | Hover | Active | Disabled | Loading | Focus.
- iconPlacement: none | left | right | left + right.
- variant: light | strong (stroke weight emphasis).
- Size: sm | md.
- Theme: Dark | Light. Light is the white outline for dark and media surfaces, it binds color/border/on-overlay and inverts the label on Hover, Active and Focus.
